run_paws_training: run the PAWS self-supervised training loop with distributed data parallel support and mixed precision
init_model_encoder: build a ResNet or WideResNet encoder with a projection head and optional prediction head
init_opt_optimizer: create an LARS-wrapped SGD optimizer with warmup cosine learning rate schedule for training
load_checkpoint_resume: load a training checkpoint to resume encoder, optimizer, and gradient scaler state
main_entry: run the main training entry point that initializes data loaders, model, optimizer, and training loop
